name: ism433-sensors
description: Decode the sensor readings of every short-range weather and temperature sensor of the 433 MHz ISM band at once (wh2, nexus, oregon_v21, wh1080, bresser_3ch): the chain of ism433_pulses followed by sensor_decode, one JSON text packet per reading.

rf.description: RTL-SDR IQ at 2 MS/s centred at 433.92 MHz

readings.description: One packet per reading: the JSON text of the reading (model, id, values, mic, freq_MHz, rssi_dB, repeats), indexed like the pulse train it came from
